process.detail: Access for the machines, fences, trees and stumps, sprinklers and utilities — all checked first. The equipment needs a clear path from the road to the pool site.
A template of the pool is laid where you want it, so you can check the size, shape and spot before anything is dug.
Nulook meets the excavator on site and stays until digging starts. Most digs take a day. Measurements are laser-checked.

process.step: Crane it in, fill it up
process.detail: The shell is craned onto the prepared base, plumbed and backfilled, then filled and leak-checked. This is where the kids can help.
A steel-reinforced concrete bond beam is poured round the pool, then the paving and landscaping finish it off.

faq.q: What kind of pools does Nulook put in?
faq.a: In-ground fibreglass pools, from a range of 14 shapes — from the 4m x 2.8m Torrens flat-bottom exercise pool up to the 13.5m x 5m Diamantina — with many colour options.

faq.q: Do you do the paving and landscaping too?
faq.a: Yes. Nulook offers a complete package including full landscaping, tiling and paving using local contractors, so you don't have to source several quotes and organise separate trades to finish the job.

faq.q: Can I see where the pool will sit before you dig?
faq.a: Yes. A template of the pool is laid on the ground where you want it, so you can make sure you're happy with the size, shape and location first.

faq.q: How long does the dig take?
faq.a: Excavations can usually be completed in one day. Large fibreglass pools, or jobs where dirt has to be re-handled, can take longer.

A clear, unobstructed path between the road and the pool site, so the equipment can get onto the block. Fences, trees and stumps, sprinklers and utilities are all checked when the property is surveyed.
The Canberra ACT region and surrounding NSW areas, including but not limited to Murrumbateman, Yass, Goulburn, Bungendore, Queanbeyan and Gundagai.
